title: Deeper/broader ACIS analytic-control author and evidence-boundary refresh
scope: Recheck source-free SAB authoring options for locally generated analytic controls.
Separate inner SAB save profile from drawing version, carrier/owner association, semantic geometry, and native acceptance.
Refine existing control-author and composed semantic gates without adding dependencies, fixtures, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of versioned API documentation and project SAB support notes
method.evidenceRule: Versioned authoring API documentation establishes only its declared generated profile. It does not establish independent producer behavior, a valid external ACIS solid, carrier/owner association, or native consumer acceptance.

evidence.observed: The docs describe a bounded BoxSpec/SabEncoder ASM23200MetricBox profile with 86 active entities and an experimental analytic BrepSpec profile for planes, circular cylinders, lines, circles, and ellipses. The analytic path has no pcurves; it expects kernel derivation. Arbitrary source history and whole-document IPT/DWG/DXF integration are not provided. AcisModel validation proves referential closure, not B-rep validity or producer/native compatibility.
doesNotEstablish: General SAT/SAB authoring or support for unlisted record/topology families
AutoCAD producer compatibility or a valid independently authored DWG/DXF sample
Independent ACIS parser/kernel semantics or FreeCAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Optional scratch-only control author when an existing implementation slice needs a matching documented profile. Pin archive/checksum, source, toolchain, features, save profile, and output bytes; keep metrics independently derived and do not commit generated drawings.

evidence.observed: The cq-acis/acis-core route is bounded by documented save profiles and supported record grammar; version acceptance does not promise every geometry layout. Unsupported records may remain raw, history remains opaque, and outer-container extraction is separate. acis-core and cq-acis are one project/parser lineage. CADMPEG is a distinct repository and published parser workspace; its docs cite CADMPEG format notes as tag-grammar context and the published dependency summaries do not list acis-core, but source overlap was not audited. CadQuery/OCCT conversion shares kernel lineage with FreeCAD.
doesNotEstablish: An independent semantic oracle from same-lineage readback
Code-level independence between the CADMPEG and acis-core parser implementations
DWG/DXF carrier preservation or complete owner graph
evidence.planUse: Use CADMPEG only as a potentially separate parser candidate after exact source/release pinning, profile matching, and narrow source-overlap review. Keep source-authoring profile, parsed records, carrier/owner closure, kernel semantics, and native acceptance as separate receipt fields.

evidence.observed: Autodesk specifies DXF 3DSOLID group 70 as the modeler format version, group 1/3 as proprietary payload lines, and group 350 as a soft-owner history handle. This is distinct from an inner SAB save version and from DWG AcDs section/index records.
doesNotEstablish: A conversion rule from ASM 23200 profile to a particular drawing version
ACIS record validity or history semantics
DWG AcDs association or native solid reconstruction
evidence.planUse: Keep payload save profile, drawing AC code, DXF group-70 marker/history link, and DWG AcDs container evidence as distinct versioned fields.

limitations: The versioned documentation is a project contract, not a locally executed conformance result.
No crate archive, source revision, or generated payload was independently inspected in this research pass; CADMPEG/acis-core code overlap remains unaudited.
No new route closes the native Linux/Windows FreeCAD or independent semantic-evidence gates.
